_comment: Least-privilege policy for the role that SIGNS presigned URLs.
AWS Prescriptive Guidance: 'A presigned URL cannot provide access to
resources that weren't granted to the principal that generated the
signature.' The scope of this policy is therefore the true blast radius of
every presigned URL the application ever issues.
NOTE THE LIMIT: this is as narrow as it goes. There is no way to express
'this principal may read objects belonging to org X only', because org
membership lives in Postgres and IAM cannot see it. Every presigned URL
this role can sign for org A, it can equally sign for org B. Cross-org
isolation is 100% application logic with zero infrastructure backstop.
